The eight-bit shapes agree to within the last bit. facts/Accelerate/vImageYpCbCr.md holds the counts and what has been fixed Answers Conversion.h's formula, and the system does not. It is a fixed-point pipeline whose coefficients are not published, and a fitted rule would be reproducing an 82-unit error. Over 760480 samples of the two ten-bit shapes the two differ on 63.4 per cent, and the differential holds the port to the formula written out independently in the test (facts/Accelerate/vImageYpCbCr.md)

entries.effect: the same arithmetic as the eight-bit source's, over samples the caller scaled from 0 to 4096, packed into the word by the header's diagram; the refusals are the system's own, kvImageRoiLargerThanInputBuffer for a destination larger than the source, kvImageUnknownFlagsBit for a flag outside DoNotTile and PrintDiagnosticsToConsole, and kvImageInvalidParameter for a permutation map that is not a permutation of 0 to 3 This one answers Conversion.h's formula, not the system's: the system does not clamp a Q12 source, wraps each ten-bit channel modulo 1024 instead, and puts 258 on the luma of a zero pixel where the formula gives the bias. Measured over 11200 words, the two differ on 95.71 per cent, widest 2146876419 on a word read as a signed difference; facts/Accelerate/vImageYpCbCr.md holds the sweep and the differential holds the port to the header's formula, written out a third time in the test NOT YET VERIFIED against the system for the shapes whose samples are 10 or 16 bits wide: the differential records 1377 failures over the family, every one of them in a ten-bit or sixteen-bit shape, and this entry is one of them. The eight-bit shapes agree to within the last bit. facts/Accelerate/vImageYpCbCr.md holds the counts and what has been fixed Answers Conversion.h's formula, and the system does not. Measured: the layout is exactly the header's drawing (a bit-by-bit sweep shows Cb in bits 0-9 moving only the green, Cr in bits 20-29 the red and green, Yp in bits 10-19 the green and the blue, and each field's own sweep smooth and monotonic), and the path is NOT affine: a least-squares fit of the full 3x3 and bias over 10000 random pixels has a worst residual of 175-178, and a search of 2304 rules of the form each field read 8 to 16 bits wide and divided by 1 to 16 bottoms out at a residual of 82. It is a fixed-point pipeline whose coefficients are not published, and a fitted rule would be reproducing an 82-unit error. Over 760480 samples of the two ten-bit shapes the two differ on 63.4 per cent, and the differential holds the port to the formula written out independently in the test (facts/Accelerate/vImageYpCbCr.md)
